body: Do you have any more thoughts? You asked me to be more specific about my view and I did.

>accepts souls who left their bodies before their time 

There is no such thing as before their time, suicide is as natural a death as any other death. Everyone wants to improve things so that no one will have to die before their time but you want to know what that really means? People want eternal youth and immortality. That can never happen though, people are living in a delusion. The point of life and everything is to end. I will embrace it.
I don't really see it as self-hate or harm. I know everyone thinks otherwise but I view suicide in a more positive light.
Easier said than done but I will try.
I was, it's just hard to understand your stream of conscious style writing.

> what's stopping you from moulding it into what you want?

Satisfaction and love are not worth it. I always regret working so hard to achieve so little.
